symbols.name: IDbContextResolver
symbols.summary: Resolves Entity Framework Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext instances at runtime for transactional behaviors and other cross-cutting concerns.
symbols.remarks: Supports two resolution forms: - By context name (string): logical name that may omit the "DbContext" suffix (e.g., "Core" resolves to "CoreDbContext"). The resolver locates the corresponding DbContext type once and caches it, then retrieves the instance from DI. - By type (Type): the exact Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext derived type. The resolver retrieves the instance from DI without any reflection or lookup. Requirements: - The DbContext type must be registered in DI using AddDbContext<TContext>(). - For name-based resolution, the DbContext type must be loadable in the current AppDomain.

symbols.name: Resolve(string)
symbols.summary: Resolves a Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext by a logical context name that may omit the "DbContext" suffix (e.g., "Core" or "CoreDbContext").

parameters.description: The logical context name or the DbContext simple type name. If the value does not end with "DbContext", the suffix will be appended for matching.

returns.description: A Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext instance resolved from the DI container.
